about: The large-scale bias of DESI-like luminous red galaxies in photometric-redshift bins, measured by Zhou et al. 2021 (MNRAS 501, 3309; arXiv:2001.06018) from projected correlation functions with a halo-occupation fit. Transcribed by hand for notes/correlated_bias_prior_v2 (the section on what the measurements say); plot_zhou_lrg_bias.py derives the residual around the constant clustering amplitude b = B/D(z) from these inputs.
